svg.text: Mob farm: where to put it

g.text: facing: the way the farm goes

svg.text: the 2x2 drop shaft comes down here:
1 block in front, in front and front-right
spawning room, 32 up by default (18 x 18 inside), centred
turtle on the ground, where you'll stand
slot 1: a stack of the block to build with
• Open sky above. Over an ocean or far from caves is best (fewer mobs elsewhere using up the mob cap).
• The buffer chest is needed with Sophisticated Storage barrels as the supply chest.
